banner: The guitar and ukulele fingerings in this dictionary were normalized using harmonic formulas and automated playability criteria — they weren't fingered by hand by a musician. We recommend a musical curation/validation pass before treating them as a definitive editorial reference. Keyboard positions are derived directly from music theory (root + inversions), so they're verifiable by construction.
